title: Encoder descriptor capability probe scaffold
summary: Add descriptor-owned encoder capability probe helpers for the dormant encoder catalog without changing active encoder selection or FFmpeg command generation.
reason: The encoder breadth/AV1 work needs host capability evidence before dormant H.264/AV1/QSV/AMF descriptors can be safely activated. This slice adds the probe scaffold and focused coverage while preserving current HEVC/libx265 behavior.
behavior_before: Encoder descriptors could build flags and resolve current HEVC/libx265 selections, but the dormant descriptor catalog had no shared list/runtime availability probe helper. Active encoder routing still relied on existing NVENC-specific probes elsewhere.
behavior_after: Encoder descriptors expose reusable list/runtime capability probe helpers with exact ffmpeg encoder-list matching, optional one-frame lavfi runtime probing, cache separation for list-only versus runtime checks, and missing-ffmpeg failure reporting. The helpers are not wired into active resolver or Do-Encode paths.
